scope: Owned DSH, actual shared-host file actions for three native engines and existing native keyboard routes.
checks: Vector, Photo and Deck: cancel Save As without switching; Save Copy retains source; Save As opens an independent same-content copy; Close preserves the saved source.
Custom-size creation saved the requested native dimensions in all three engines and also works from an empty project; cancel and an oversized area retained the original source.
Photo and Deck native Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Shift+S and cancelled Ctrl+O still route through the host after the shared actions were added.
limits: Native file menus and some redundant controls are still visible; this does not yet satisfy the entire single-entry host-mode requirement.
The test uses an owned DSH/browser, not the user’s current desktop window.
